title: Why is Thunderbird all of a sudden sending emails with TWO of my addresses attached?
creator: Chicks_Hate_Me
content:
All of a sudden, I go to send an email on one account. and Account I use on people I do not trust yet, And ALL OF A SUDDEN, the email is put in my Most protected email account, as sent. And when I LOOK, the sent email has BOTH emails as "FROM". Talk about insecure and a violation.

Now my IMPORTANT and PROTECTED email is out there with people I don't trust so much. Thanks. Is it from a recent Botched Update?

The work Ahead is gonna kill me .
